Results.ReviewText: We've used a Weber Propane grill exclusively for more than 20 years...even repairing bits and pieces that failed after 15 years of hard wear and tear.  Finally, we decided it was time to replace our 2-burner old faithful with a new Weber, and boy, are we glad we did!  As much as we enjoyed using our old, smaller Weber grill, our new, 3 burner unit is even better!  We have about 30% more room on the grill surface so we can easily feed 12-15 hungry people burgers, steaks or chicken!  And, what's more, it heats up SO FAST!  I used to anticipate about 10 minutes to come up to a top temperature of about 475 degrees, but with the new grill, it takes about 5 minutes, and we're at 500 or even 550 degrees!  It's wonderfully adjustable, and does a great job searing as well as slower cooking when needed.  We are delighted with this purchase!  We bought our grill pre-assembled, at Home Depot.

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello we are sorry to hear about the issues you have experienced with your grill. It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:



-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.



-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.



-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.



-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.



-Close the grill lid.



-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.



When you are done grilling:



-Turn all burner control knobs to the OFF position



-Turn off the LP tank valve last. If you continue to experience issues please contact our support team so we may further assist. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my Spirit II E-310 new, fully assembled from Home Depot this spring.  When I got it home and tried to hook up the gas tank, I noticed that the tank holder was installed inside of the unit instead of on the outside.  So I moved the tank holder to the outside and prepared to grill.  The grill would not light, even though I followed directions.  So the next day I returned the grill to Home Depot.  Just what I wanted to do in this time of a pandemic.  Naturally I had to go to 2 different areas inside of Home Depot and stand in two lines to return it and secure another grill.  I loaded up the second grill and returned home.  The second one lit fine and I made 2 meals before it malfunctioned.  This time the grill would not achieve a temperature above 225 degrees.  I shut it off, disconnected the gas line, and then re-connected it.  This time it lit and achieved a cooking temperature.  So out of three tries I had two failures.  Not a good record.
Results.Title: Not satisfied so far with the performance

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Our previous Weber had lasted well over a decade.  When it came time to replace it we did some research, asked some friends and neighbors and regrettably bought another brand...no sooner did we bring it home than we realized the foolish mistake we made in the name of saving money.  We never even hooked the gas up to it.  Once we returned that jagged hunk of steel that was a laceration waiting to happen, we went back and did the right thing and stuck with the brand we knew and that most if not every review listed as the best grill for "just about anyone."  The Spirit 310 is solidly built, an upgrade of a third burner from our previous two and couldn't work better.  In the weeks since its arrival, we've grilled as often as the weather and groceries would allow.  We are not pit masters at all, but are able to produce exceptional meals start to finish on the grill -- whether with a Weber grill basket for vegetables or our own cast iron skillet directly on the grates.  Brand loyalty is earned and Weber has never disappointed.
Results.Title: We strayed from Weber...for about 15 minutes.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is our 4th Weber Gas Grill over our 52 years of marriage so we wouldn't buy anything else. Love cooking on the Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Really disappointed With this grill. It has large wheels on one side and it looks like you can pick it up and move it around but it’s very hard to move. Results.Title: Webber, I want my money back.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have had my share of grills over the years and Weber is the best. I have owned several other brands and when we needed a new grill, we decided on a medium size Weber for our cabin. This 3-burner is the best option for the size and does a great job with indirect heat. We have hooked it up to house propane. I could not reach Weber customer support to get their bulk LP adapter kit but our gas company came out and did it. LP gas burns hotter than natural gas so I have had to learn to turn down the gas with more delicate foods like chicken breasts and salmon burgers. Even burgers are cooked 1-2 notches down from full high. Great sear marks, very tasty food. Cast iron grates are easy to clean. Delivery was great with UPS and set up were very easy. Highly recommend this grill!!
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.Title: Nothing Beats It

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber grills for decades.  This is my second Weber gas grill.  I had the last one for about 20 years before I moved and did not take it with me.  I figured it was about time for a new one.  This one is absolutely great.  I ordered it assembled from Ace Hardware and was really pleased with the price, courtesy, delivery and assembly.  I did have to fix the LP Tank hanger that they installed upside down and reinsert the starter battery which they put in opposite poles.  But after that, all went even better than I expected, and I had high expectations.  Everything I cook turns out as good or better than I expect, and cleanup is a breeze.  The Weber cover is worth the extra money, by the way.  This particular grill was recommended as the best LP Gas grill to get by Wirecutter.  Recommended even over $1000 grills.  I got a great value and expect this one to last well beyond its 10 year warranty.
Results.Title: Just get it.

Results.ReviewText: So far, I've been very pleased with the grill.  I wish there were wheels on the non-wheel legs.  The real test is how long the self starter lasts.  On previous non-Weber grills, six months is probably the longest.  I like the construction of the grill.  It appears that it will not rust away like my last two non-Weber grills.  Instructions to put grill together were very easy to understand but I was shorted a couple of the rubber washers even with the extras given.  I called them and they were mailed to me.  Only time will tell about the grill but so far I am pleased.
